objects.description: Abstract callback interface (SPI) for the Market Data API. Users implement this to receive connection status, login/logout responses, subscription responses, depth market data ticks, and quote responses. All methods are virtual with empty defaults; override those you need. Lifetime is managed by user; register with CThostFtdcMdApi::RegisterSpi.

Main Market Data API class. Provides factory CreateFtdcMdApi, version query, lifecycle (Init, Join, Release), connection registration, user/FENS registration, subscription interfaces for market data and quote responses, and login/logout requests. Implementations are provided by the vendor (exported via MD_API_EXPORT). User obtains an instance via CreateFtdcMdApi and must call Release when done.

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnFrontConnected
functions.description: SPI callback invoked when the client successfully connects to the front (server) before login. Implement this in your derived CThostFtdcMdSpi to start login or other initialization.
requirements: Must be implemented in a subclass of CThostFtdcMdSpi to receive the event
No parameters; no return value

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnFrontDisconnected
functions.description: SPI callback invoked when the connection to the front is disconnected. Use nReason to diagnose cause and implement reconnection logic.
requirements: nReason is an integer reason code. Header comment lists examples: 0x1001 (network read error), 0x1002 (network write error), 0x2001 (heartbeat timeout), 0x2002 (other errors), 0x2003 (max login attempts). Exact meanings may vary

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnHeartBeatWarning
functions.description: SPI callback for heartbeat warning when no data is received for a period. nTimeLapse is the time since last data.
requirements: nTimeLapse is the time elapsed since last received message (units not explicitly specified in header; typical is seconds)

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRspUserLogin
functions.signature: virtual void OnRspUserLogin(CThostFtdcRspUserLoginField *pRspUserLogin, CThostFtdcRspInfoField *pRspInfo, int nRequestID, bool bIsLast)
functions.description: SPI callback for response to a user login request. Inspect pRspInfo to determine success and use pRspUserLogin for session/trading day info.
requirements: pRspUserLogin may point to a CThostFtdcRspUserLoginField with session and time fields (may be null on error; not explicitly stated)
pRspInfo points to error info (may be null on success; not explicitly stated)
nRequestID is the request ID supplied in ReqUserLogin
bIsLast indicates if this is the last response in the series

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRspUserLogout
functions.signature: virtual void OnRspUserLogout(CThostFtdcUserLogoutField *pUserLogout, CThostFtdcRspInfoField *pRspInfo, int nRequestID, bool bIsLast)
functions.description: SPI callback for response to a user logout request.
requirements: pUserLogout may contain BrokerID and UserID of the logout request (may be null on error; not explicitly stated)
pRspInfo contains error/result info (may be null on success; not explicitly stated)
nRequestID matches the original ReqUserLogout
bIsLast indicates last response

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRspError
functions.signature: virtual void OnRspError(CThostFtdcRspInfoField *pRspInfo, int nRequestID, bool bIsLast)
functions.description: SPI callback delivering an error response for a previously sent request or an asynchronous error.
requirements: pRspInfo points to error details (ErrorID, ErrorMsg)
nRequestID may correspond to the request that caused the error
bIsLast indicates last response for the related request

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRspSubMarketData
functions.signature: virtual void OnRspSubMarketData(CThostFtdcSpecificInstrumentField *pSpecificInstrument, CThostFtdcRspInfoField *pRspInfo, int nRequestID, bool bIsLast)
functions.description: SPI callback for response to SubscribeMarketData. Provides status per instrument subscription.
requirements: pSpecificInstrument points to the instrument ID the response refers to (may be null on error; not explicitly stated)
pRspInfo contains error/result info per instrument
nRequestID matches the original SubscribeMarketData request ID if used by caller
bIsLast indicates last response for this request

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRspUnSubMarketData
functions.signature: virtual void OnRspUnSubMarketData(CThostFtdcSpecificInstrumentField *pSpecificInstrument, CThostFtdcRspInfoField *pRspInfo, int nRequestID, bool bIsLast)
functions.description: SPI callback for response to UnSubscribeMarketData. Provides unsubscription status per instrument.
requirements: pSpecificInstrument points to the instrument ID affected (may be null on error; not explicitly stated)
pRspInfo contains error/result info
nRequestID matches the original unsubscription request
bIsLast indicates last response

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRspSubForQuoteRsp
functions.signature: virtual void OnRspSubForQuoteRsp(CThostFtdcSpecificInstrumentField *pSpecificInstrument, CThostFtdcRspInfoField *pRspInfo, int nRequestID, bool bIsLast)
functions.description: SPI callback for response to SubscribeForQuoteRsp (inquiry subscription).
requirements: pSpecificInstrument points to the instrument ID (may be null on error; not explicitly stated)
pRspInfo contains error/result info
nRequestID matches the original subscription request
bIsLast indicates last response

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRspUnSubForQuoteRsp
functions.signature: virtual void OnRspUnSubForQuoteRsp(CThostFtdcSpecificInstrumentField *pSpecificInstrument, CThostFtdcRspInfoField *pRspInfo, int nRequestID, bool bIsLast)
functions.description: SPI callback for response to UnSubscribeForQuoteRsp (unsubscribe inquiry).
requirements: pSpecificInstrument points to the instrument ID (may be null on error; not explicitly stated)
pRspInfo contains error/result info
nRequestID matches the original unsubscription request
bIsLast indicates last response

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRtnDepthMarketData
functions.description: SPI callback that delivers real-time depth market data ticks for subscribed instruments.
requirements: pDepthMarketData points to a CThostFtdcDepthMarketDataField with quote fields (must be treated as read-only; lifetime managed by API; exact ownership not specified)

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdSpi::OnRtnForQuoteRsp
functions.description: SPI callback that delivers for-quote responses (inquiry responses) for subscribed instruments.
requirements: pForQuoteRsp points to a CThostFtdcForQuoteRspField payload (read-only; lifetime managed by API; exact ownership not specified)

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::CreateFtdcMdApi
functions.signature: static CThostFtdcMdApi *CreateFtdcMdApi(const char *pszFlowPath = "", const bool bIsUsingUdp = false, const bool bIsMulticast = false)
functions.description: Factory to create an instance of the market-data API. pszFlowPath sets the flow (persistence) directory; by default the current directory. Optional flags enable UDP market data and multicast mode.
requirements: pszFlowPath is a null-terminated path string; may be empty to use current directory
bIsUsingUdp toggles UDP market data mode (modify for UDP per comment)
bIsMulticast toggles multicast if UDP mode is used
Returns a non-null pointer on success or null on failure (return condition not explicitly stated; typical factory semantics)

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::GetApiVersion
functions.description: Returns a string with the API version.
requirements: Returns a null-terminated string owned by the library; treat as read-only

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::Release
functions.description: Destroys/releases the API instance. After calling Release, the API object must not be used.
requirements: Must be called to release resources when done using the API instance
Do not use the API pointer after calling Release

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::Init
functions.description: Initializes the API and starts its internal threads. Must be called before the API begins operation.
requirements: Call after creating the API and after registering front/spi as needed
May spawn internal threads; do not block in callbacks to avoid deadlocks (not explicitly stated; general guidance)

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::Join
functions.description: Blocks the calling thread until the API’s worker thread exits and returns its exit code.
requirements: Call typically after Init() to wait for API threads to finish
Return value is a thread exit code (exact semantics not specified)

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::GetTradingDay
functions.description: Returns the current trading day string for the connected front. The header notes you get the correct value only after a successful login.
requirements: Call after successful login to obtain a correct trading day
Returns a null-terminated string owned by the API; treat as read-only

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::RegisterFront
functions.description: Registers the front (server) address for the API to connect to. Address format is protocol://ipaddress:port, e.g., tcp://127.0.0.1:17001.
requirements: pszFrontAddress must be a writable null-terminated string matching format protocol://ip:port (e.g., tcp://127.0.0.1:17001)
Must be called before Init() so the API knows where to connect

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::RegisterNameServer
functions.description: Registers a name server address for the API to resolve front addresses. Format is protocol://ipaddress:port, e.g., tcp://127.0.0.1:12001. Using RegisterNameServer is an alternative to RegisterFront.
requirements: pszNsAddress must be a writable null-terminated string matching protocol://ip:port (e.g., tcp://127.0.0.1:12001)
Per comment: RegisterNameServer and RegisterFront are alternative methods; do not rely on both unless library supports it
Call before Init()

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::RegisterFensUserInfo
functions.description: Registers FENS (front-end network service) user info for front discovery/logon routing.
requirements: pFensUserInfo must point to a valid CThostFtdcFensUserInfoField populated with BrokerID, UserID, and LoginMode
Call before Init() so connection setup can use it

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::RegisterSpi
functions.description: Registers the SPI (callback) instance that receives asynchronous events and data.
requirements: pSpi must be a valid pointer to a CThostFtdcMdSpi-derived instance
The SPI instance should remain valid until after Release() to avoid callbacks to a destroyed object

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::SubscribeMarketData
functions.description: Subscribes to depth market data for a list of instruments.
requirements: ppInstrumentID is an array of pointers to instrument ID C-strings; each must be a valid null-terminated instrument identifier
nCount is the number of instrument IDs in ppInstrumentID; must be non-negative and match the array length

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::UnSubscribeMarketData
functions.description: Unsubscribes depth market data for a list of instruments.
requirements: ppInstrumentID is an array of pointers to instrument ID C-strings
nCount is the number of instrument IDs; must be non-negative and match the array length

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::SubscribeForQuoteRsp
functions.description: Subscribes to for-quote responses (inquiry responses) for a list of instruments.
requirements: ppInstrumentID is an array of pointers to instrument ID C-strings
nCount is the number of instrument IDs; must be non-negative and match the array length

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::UnSubscribeForQuoteRsp
functions.description: Unsubscribes for-quote responses for a list of instruments.
requirements: ppInstrumentID is an array of pointers to instrument ID C-strings
nCount is the number of instrument IDs; must be non-negative and match the array length

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::ReqUserLogin
functions.description: Sends a user login request. Response arrives via OnRspUserLogin.
requirements: pReqUserLoginField must point to a valid CThostFtdcReqUserLoginField populated with at least BrokerID, UserID, and Password (other optional fields per struct)
nRequestID is a caller-supplied identifier to correlate responses

functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::ReqUserLogout
functions.description: Sends a user logout request. Response arrives via OnRspUserLogout.
requirements: pUserLogout must point to a valid CThostFtdcUserLogoutField populated with BrokerID and UserID
nRequestID is a caller-supplied request identifier

unharnessable_functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::Init
unharnessable_functions.reason: Init may spawn threads and initiate network operations, leading to blocking or nondeterministic behavior unsuitable for a single-call fuzz stub.

unharnessable_functions.name: CThostFtdcMdApi::Join
unharnessable_functions.reason: Join is a blocking call that waits for worker thread exit and cannot be exercised safely within a non-blocking fuzz stub.

data_types.description: A null-terminated string representing a filesystem directory path. May be empty to indicate the current directory. Can include relative or absolute paths and typical path characters (letters, digits, slashes, backslashes, dots, underscores). Used here as the flow/persistence directory for API state.

A null-terminated ASCII string representing a market instrument ID/symbol as expected by the CTP/Thost MD API. Typically short (<=31 chars in these stubs), alphanumeric with optional underscores or suffixes. Provided as writable C-strings in an array for subscription/unsubscription calls.
